subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3583
title: Requires the sentencing court to consider as mitigation evidence whether the defendant was subjected to domestic violence that was ongoing when the criminal behavior occurred and was a significant factor in the criminal behavior, and the criminal behavior was directed against the domestic violence perpetrator.
headline: HB 3583 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3583 was introduced in the House on February 18, 2025.
HB 3583 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
